description: Drag from one UI element to another (sliders, selections, list items) with the physical pointer; from_index/to_index come from mac_ax_state or mac_find (valid 30 s). Both ends are re-identified and hit-tested first (either one gone or covered: nothing sent). hold_ms (0-2000) presses and holds after mouse-down before the move starts (timeline editors use it to tell clip-move from marquee selection); step_ms (1-500) moves in steps of about 20 points with that many ms between them. A drag whose holds and steps add up to more than 10 s is refused; a drag that fails midway gets a mouse-up so the button is not left held. Check the drop target afterwards.
name: mac_drag
